drivingQuestion: What measure of cutting the windpipe renders the animal a tereifa, and how is that 'majority' reckoned?
outcomeNote: The unit breaks off mid-answer: Rav's definition of 'its majority' is supplied only in chullin.sugya112 (רוב עוביה / רוב חללה).

segments.he: וּפְסוּקַת הַגַּרְגֶּרֶת. תָּנָא: כַּמָּה פְּסוּקַת הַגַּרְגֶּרֶת? בְּרוּבָּהּ. וְכַמָּה רוּבָּה? רַב אָמַר:
segments.en: § The mishna states: «Or» an animal with «a cut windpipe,» cut across its width, is a tereifa. With regard to this the Sages «taught: How much» must «the windpipe» be «cut» to render the animal a tereifa? «In its majority. And how much is its majority? Rav says:»
